This achievement is still utopian, since the humans of the Earth do not have a sufficient cultural base to become aware of the political structure which suits them in order truly to transform themselves into truly free OEMII. But each of you has the obligation to arouse in those around him the future necessity of forming part of a more just and organised socio-political architecture.
In the democratic ideology of the West, elements exist usable for this future plan.
Christian philosophy and Hinduism can contribute very important ethical elements, Marxism, stripped of dogmatic and totalitarian components, is the most important source for this city of the future. From the ruins of your respective models in force and a part of the old demolished materials, your grandchildren will build a more human metropolis, freed from neurotic factors generating the present anguish of the humans of the Earth. It will not yet be a perfect social Network but it will resemble much more the model of our Society of UMMO.
It will be a true Ethocracy. The reign of negentropic morality.
In other reports, we will offer you a sketched outline of how this model could be structured, paying attention to the singularities of the brains of the OEMII of OYAAGAA.

Title of the letter: Greetings card to Stefano Breccia
Date: 12/1975
Recipients: Mr Stefano Breccia
Original language: Russian
Notes: A greetings card sent from Leningrad (Saint Petersburg).
Stefano Breccia reproduced this card in his book “Mass Contacts” (ISBN13: 9781438906782) published by AuthorHouse, page 78.
Stefano explains in his book about this card: “These gentlemen addressed me in a classic Russian style, with first name, patronymic and surname. I think that very few people, mainly people of my family, know that the name of my father was Aldo, hence the letter ‘A’. [...] There is a small error in the date (a ‘Г’ is missing after 1975), but one cannot expect too much!”
This greetings card is so short that it is difficult to assess the veracity of the source. On 03/09/2015 I asked the question on twitter to OOMO TOA, who marked this question as a favourite (cf OT-Like 4), which seems to confirm its authenticity. Be careful all the same: as with any Ummite document present on this site, it is impossible to have any certainty whatsoever about its origin.
